rendered:
The solvent with the strongest hydrogen bonding in the paper is water. The paper states that water also has strong hydrogen bonding, with a δH value of 42.3 MPa^1/2[1]. This is higher than the other solvents discussed: EG has a δH of 26.0[2] in the solubility-parameter table, glycerol 29.3[3] and diethylene glycol 20.7[4].

Why water is not used for delamination: water is not suitable because lithium leaching from the NMC cathode makes the water solution basic, which corrodes the aluminum foil. The corrosion then contaminates the NMC particles, since the aluminum forms Al(OH)3 precipitates on the cathode surfaces.[5][6]
